tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
New York passes laws to protect kids from unsafe chatbots and baby monitors. Confirmed by WKTV: Governor Hochul signed these safety measures into law.
Texas sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT safety concerns and age verification. Reported by Biometric Update: the state is taking legal action.
GitHub launches Copilot Fusion and multi-agent projects at Universe 2026, enabling artificial intelligence coordination in development. Confirmed by Crypto Briefing: these tools expand what developers can do.
The US Department of Justice is inquiring about Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face. Reported by Reuters: sources say the agency is investigating the deal.
A UK politician fought back against deepfakes created by Grok, leading to a government ban on nudification apps and calls for artificial intelligence chatbot regulation. Confirmed by Wired: Jess Asato took legal action against Elon Musk's xAI.
Free every hour.
